title: Watersound 37 Compass Point Way Unit 109
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Gated Community with on-site Security- Private deeded beach access- Minutes to the nearest beach boardwalk- 4-Passenger golf cart- 3 adult bikes- From March 1st to October 31st, 2024, the rental of this property includes one beach -service set (2 beach chairs and 1 umbrella)- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutThis property comes with 1 designated parking space and 1 first-come first-serve parking space. Please note first come first serve parking is limited and not guaranteed. This home permits a maximum of 2 vehicles through the community security gate.DETAILS: Nestled among the picturesque white sand dunes, Watersound 37 Compass Point Way Unit 109 is an attractive WaterSound condo with 3 bedrooms and 3.5 bathrooms that comfortably accommodates 8 guests. This gated Emerald Coast community includes swimming pools, puttering parks, greenspaces, and a fitness center—minutes from the beach and a quick walk from dining and entertainment at The Big Chill. Guests will love drinking in the scenic views from the spacious porches of this condo!Serene elegance enraptures guests inside this reverse floor plan home. On the bottom level, discover a guest bedroom with a king bed, private bathroom, and a porch with private entry—perfect for lounging in the sun or slipping out for a late-night stroll on the boardwalk. An extra sleeping area has 1 twin-over-twin bunk bed with charging ports and individual lights in each bunk.On the second floor waits the open great room, outfitted with hardwood floors, custom artwork, and designer furnishings. Enjoy making meals in the beautifully appointed kitchen, featuring quartz countertops and high-end appliances. There is room for 6 to dine at the sleek dinner table and 3 additional seats at the breakfast bar. Kick back and relax together on the couch and 4 armchairs in the living space—the 65” Samsung Smart TV makes it a breeze to stream a family favorite show or movie. End a peaceful beach day on the balcony, breathing in the coastal air and enjoying the gorgeous views. There are 2 comfortable guest bedrooms with private bathrooms on this floor—the first has a queen bed and the second 2 twin beds. A dry bar with refrigerated drawers offers an ideal spot to store cocktail ingredients or water and snacks for night owls.Delight in nearby sugar-sand beaches and WaterSound’s exclusive amenities at Watersound 37 Compass Point Way Unit 109. Exploring the area is simple, with 3 complimentary adult bikes, on-site parking, and plenty of winding wooden boardwalks. Alys, Seacrest, and Rosemary Beaches are all within biking distance. Book this charming condo for an unforgettable vacation today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (Sleeps 8):FIRST FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Separate- Additional Sleeping Area: Twin-over-Twin Bunk BedSECOND FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: Two Twin Beds, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo*Watersound Community Highlights:-Over 250 Acre Gated Beach Community on the Gulf of Mexico between Seaside and Rosemary Beach-(2) Community Pools (Dunesider Pool in Main Gate and Bridges Pool within the Bridges Gate)-Kayak Rentals-Parks, Walking Trails and Meandering Boardwalks-Bike to Alys, Seacrest and Rosemary Beach-A short walk to The Big ChillPlease Note:*From October 2025 through 2026, WaterSound Compass Point will undergo major exterior refurbishment. Residents and guests should expect construction, boarded windows, limited balcony and garage access, and possible parking disruptions. These safety measures are essential for project completion.*Access to the Watersound Beach Club is not included.*Watersound does not allow golf cart rentals from outside vendors.*Weddings or parties/groups of people or guest of guest are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments and be subject to HOA, community, and 360 Blue fines.

DETAILS: Nestled among the picturesque white sand dunes, Watersound 37 Compass Point Way Unit 109 is an attractive WaterSound condo with 3 bedrooms and 3.5 bathrooms that comfortably accommodates 8 guests. This gated Emerald Coast community includes swimming pools, puttering parks, greenspaces, and a fitness center—minutes from the beach and a quick walk from dining and entertainment at The Big Chill. An extra sleeping area has 1 twin-over-twin bunk bed with charging ports and individual lights in each bunk. On the second floor waits the open great room, outfitted with hardwood floors, custom artwork, and designer furnishings. There is room for 6 to dine at the sleek dinner table and 3 additional seats at the breakfast bar. Kick back and relax together on the couch and 4 armchairs in the living space—the 65” Samsung Smart TV makes it a breeze to stream a family favorite show or movie. End a peaceful beach day on the balcony, breathing in the coastal air and enjoying the gorgeous views. There are 2 comfortable guest bedrooms with private bathrooms on this floor—the first has a queen bed and the second 2 twin beds. A dry bar with refrigerated drawers offers an ideal spot to store cocktail ingredients or water and snacks for night owls. Delight in nearby sugar-sand beaches and WaterSound’s exclusive amenities at Watersound 37 Compass Point Way Unit 109. Exploring the area is simple, with 3 complimentary adult bikes, on-site parking, and plenty of winding wooden boardwalks. Alys, Seacrest, and Rosemary Beaches are all within biking distance. Book this charming condo for an unforgettable vacation today!
